rules.title: Use design tokens
rules.text: Use design tokens for colors, spacing, typography and radii; never hardcode them.

rules.title: Reuse components
rules.text: Reuse existing components before creating new ones; extend variants instead of duplicating.

rules.title: WCAG 2.1 AA
rules.text: Meet WCAG 2.1 AA: semantic HTML, visible focus, keyboard operability, sufficient contrast, labelled controls.

rules.title: Mobile-first responsive
rules.text: Design mobile-first and verify layouts at phone, tablet and desktop widths.

rules.title: Support dark mode
rules.text: Support light and dark themes through tokens, not per-component overrides.

rules.title: Cover all UI states
rules.text: Handle loading, empty, error and disabled states for every data-driven view.

rules.title: Respect reduced motion
rules.text: Respect prefers-reduced-motion and keep animations short and purposeful.

rules.title: No hardcoded user-facing strings
rules.text: Keep user-facing strings in translation files, not inline in components.
